title: Orbit independent check result
description: Final JSON object returned by an independent check or adjudication run (Orbit 1, contracts/task-runtime.md). Strings are expected to be non-empty and next_check_seconds is a positive integer, even where JSON Schema alone cannot express it inside Codex structured output. delivery is the checker's structured delivery-readiness judgment, separate from verdict and findings: ready=true requires the actual deliverable to be inspectable at check time (the fixed artifact, or the Root's actually delivered final answer visible in the program record), never a Root claim or a verdict alone. coverage records the independent checker enumeration and evidence per requirement. Missing coverage is unknown, and cannot release a new task for completion.

requirement.description: One enumerated requirement, kept verbatim. The bound is a representation bound (a long requirement sentence must survive unmodified), not a relaxation of acceptance: missing, duplicate or oversized items are still refused and nothing is truncated.

scope.description: Delivery requirements, including actual tests, must be verified; future final-check, closing-report and confirmed-stop obligations remain listed and are verified by runtime lifecycle gates. Missing scope keeps the earlier delivery-only interpretation.
